prompt: Create a dynamic full-body 3D character illustration on a clean white background: a fierce fantasy archer with Oyagi signature style, shown in an extreme low-angle action pose as if leaping toward the viewer while aiming a bow. The character has a stylized athletic humanoid body with exaggerated foreshortening: one bare foot enormous in the foreground at the lower left, the rear leg bent back to the right, the left arm thrust forward gripping a large curved bow, and the right arm pulling the bowstring back near the face. Use a glossy clay-like 3D render aesthetic with soft studio lighting, smooth rounded forms, and no outlines. The palette is a vivid rainbow gradient with neon cyan, magenta, violet, coral, teal, yellow, and deep blue blended across skin, hair, clothing, and weapons. The character has an intense focused expression, green-yellow eyes, dark brows, colorful face markings, and thick sculptural hair made of exactly 8 large flowing tendrils sweeping backward and outward. Add decorative spiral and stripe body markings on the face, arm, thigh, and shin. The costume is minimal fantasy warrior clothing: exactly 5 visible outfit elements consisting of a wrapped chest band, a layered waist sash, a hanging front loincloth panel, a round spiral belt ornament on the right hip, and simple ankle bands. The weapon set contains exactly 2 items: one oversized curved bow with rounded joints and a cone-like arrow rest on the left side, and one long thin arrow drawn across the image from left to right. Make the bowstring taut, crossing diagonally through the composition, and place the arrow tip just past the bow. Keep the background pure white with no scenery. Add a small handwritten signature and date in the bottom-right corner reading July 30, 2026 and Oyagi. High-resolution vertical composition, dramatic foreshortening, playful toy-like anatomy, vibrant fantasy archer energy.

promptZh: 在干净的白色背景上创作一张动态的全身 3D 角色插画：一个具有 Oyagi 标志性风格的凶猛幻想弓箭手，以极端的低角度动作姿势呈现，仿佛正向观众跃起并拉弓瞄准。该角色拥有程式化的运动型人形身体，带有夸张的透视缩短效果：左下角前景中有一只巨大的赤脚，后腿向右弯曲，左臂向前伸出握着一把巨大的弯弓，右臂将弓弦拉至脸部附近。采用光泽感粘土风格的 3D 渲染美学，配以柔和的摄影棚灯光、平滑圆润的形态，且无轮廓线。调色板采用鲜艳的彩虹渐变，将 霓虹青、洋红、紫、珊瑚色、蓝绿色、黄色和深蓝色 融合在皮肤、头发、服装和武器上。角色表情专注且强烈，拥有黄绿色眼睛、深色眉毛、色彩斑斓的面部标记，以及由 8 根向后和向外飘逸的粗大卷须组成的厚实雕塑感发型。在脸部、手臂、大腿和小腿上添加装饰性的螺旋和条纹身体标记。服装为极简幻想战士装束：包含 5 个可见的服装元素，即缠绕式胸带、分层腰带、悬垂的前腰布、右臀部的圆形螺旋腰带装饰以及简单的脚踝绑带。武器组包含 2 件物品：一把带有圆润关节和左侧锥形箭托的超大弯弓，以及一支从左向右横贯画面的细长箭。使弓弦拉紧，呈对角线穿过构图，并将箭尖置于弓弦之外。保持背景为纯白色，无任何场景。在右下角添加一个小的手写签名和日期，内容为 2026 年 7 月 30 日 和 Oyagi。高分辨率垂直构图，戏剧性的透视缩短，俏皮的玩具般人体结构，充满活力的幻想弓箭手能量。
